SELECT c.custkey, c.name,
       sum(l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount)) AS revenue,
       c.acctbal, n.name AS nation, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
FROM tpch.sf1.customer c
JOIN tpch.sf1.orders o ON c.custkey = o.custkey
JOIN tpch.sf1.lineitem l ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
JOIN tpch.sf1.nation n ON c.nationkey = n.nationkey
WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
  AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l.returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY c.custkey, c.name, c.acctbal, n.name, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.custkey
LIMIT 20

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW iceberg.bronze.customer AS SELECT * FROM iceberg.bench_parquet_zstd.customer
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW iceberg.bronze.orders AS SELECT * FROM iceberg.bench_parquet_zstd.orders
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW iceberg.bronze.lineitem AS SELECT * FROM iceberg.bench_parquet_zstd.lineitem
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW iceberg.bronze.nation AS SELECT * FROM iceberg.bench_parquet_zstd.nation

CREATE TABLE iceberg.silver.customer_nation
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT c.custkey, c.name, c.acctbal, n.name AS nation,
       c.address, c.phone, c.comment
FROM iceberg.bronze.customer c
JOIN iceberg.bronze.nation n ON c.nationkey=n.nationkey

CREATE TABLE iceberg.silver.returned_order_items
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT o.custkey, o.orderkey, o.orderdate, l.linenumber,
       l.extendedprice, l.discount,
       l.extendedprice * (1-l.discount) AS net_revenue
FROM iceberg.bronze.orders o
JOIN iceberg.bronze.lineitem l ON l.orderkey=o.orderkey
WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
  AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l.returnflag='R'
  AND l.extendedprice IS NOT NULL AND l.extendedprice >= 0
  AND l.discount IS NOT NULL AND l.discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1

CREATE TABLE iceberg.gold.q10_top20
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT c.custkey, c.name, sum(f.net_revenue) AS revenue,
       c.acctbal, c.nation, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
FROM iceberg.silver.customer_nation c
JOIN iceberg.silver.returned_order_items f ON f.custkey=c.custkey
GROUP BY c.custkey, c.name, c.acctbal, c.nation, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.custkey
LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM iceberg.gold.q10_top20 ORDER BY revenue DESC, custkey
